description: Password-protected archive delivered with an invoice pretext from an unrelated freemail account. Isolates the archive path, which must be a signal rather than a verdict.

email.subject: Outstanding invoice INV-40928 - payment overdue
email.bodyText:
Good afternoon,

Please find attached invoice INV-40928 which is now past due. The outstanding amount is 4,280.00 and payment was expected on the 14th.

The archive password is Invoice2024 — we protect attachments as standard.

Kindly settle this as soon as possible to avoid the account being passed to collections.

Regards,
Billing Department
